text:
jules: Quick ask: we need a hyper-short battlecard + 3 email subject lines for the inference launch. Focus: how we compare vs cloud-managed endpoints, simple LLM APIs, and DIY infra. Can we get drafts by EOD?

pat: Yep. Keep claims outcome-focused: predictable tail latency, avoid surprise spend, and built-in fallbacks.

kai: Webinar hooks (pick 1): 1) 'Inference that behaves like a production system' 2) 'Stop surprise bills, start reliable SLAs' 3) 'Rollouts that don't break users'

sam: Quick bench snippet (internal demo, 95th pct, 4k tokens) for slide note: Redwood-Dedicated 115ms | Cloud-Managed ~235ms | API-Simple ~350ms | DIY ~420ms. Footnote: demo workload; varies.

anita: Battlecard bullets (short):
- One API across Hosted/Dedicated/Private
- Routing + automatic fallback to protect user flows
- Ops controls: canaries, KV caching, autoscale

pat: Objection handlers (one-liners):
- Cloud-managed: 'Fast to pilot; Redwood prevents surprise bills and keeps features live.'
- LLM APIs: 'Great for protos; Redwood adds rollout and cache controls for production.'
- DIY: 'Control plus lower ops tax via Private.'

legal-bot: Reminder: anonymize competitor names and include methodology on bench slide. No absolute cost claims.

jules: Landing copy variants:
A (engineer): 'Ship LLM features with predictable latency and unit economics. One API, rollout controls, and built-in fallbacks.'
B (prod): 'Deliver reliable AI experiences. Unified runtime and automatic fallbacks protect users when models falter.'

pat: Email subject candidates:
1) 'Benchmarked: lower production tail latency for inference'
2) 'How teams stop surprise inference spend'
3) 'Ship reliable AI features with predictable SLOs'

ops-bot: calendar-bot: Wed next week 11:00 PT free for webinar. Zoom reserved.

jules: Inbound routing: tag 'launch-inference' -> immediate one-pager + bench highlights; 48h demo clip; SDR touch on high-signal. Add CTA for Dedicated trial and Private brief for regulated accounts.

sam: I'll drop a tiny CLI snippet for bench appendix so folks can reproduce.

anita: Design note: anonymized bars, methodology footnote, no competitor logos.

jules: Timeline: drafts by EOD, review tomorrow 10am. Avoid leading with 'we're cheaper' 9 frame as 'predictable unit economics and lower ops risk'. Ping when assets in /marketing/webinar/prelaunch/. :rocket:
